capabilities: Collect RSS/Atom feeds into local SQLite
Screen papers across five status baskets
Prioritize the queue with a local TF-IDF model
Review pending papers with an LLM
extras: Desktop-only; requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ and a bundled Node.js 22.16+ runtime exposing node:sqlite (no sql.js fallback). Title translation is an experimental reading aid using an unofficial Google web API and is not for formal citation. No account or telemetry; the LLM key is stored in Obsidian SecretStorage. Extensive separate documentation (architecture, database, development, troubleshooting, security) is linked but hosted outside the README. LLM and translation API charges may apply.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to subscribe to academic RSS feeds and triage incoming papers into a prioritized local reading queue.

relations.evidence: When upgrading manually from the former rss-reader plugin ID
Choose Google web translation (default) or an OpenAI-compatible LLM
ask a configured OpenAI-compatible service to review only the papers that remain pending

summary: Desktop Obsidian plugin that collects academic RSS/Atom feeds into a local SQLite queue for screening, translating, and prioritizing papers.
